description:
About Eulerity 

 Eulerity is a rapidly growing technology company revolutionizing marketing automation for small businesses and franchises with our industry-leading proprietary software. Founded by leaders from Google, Facebook, and Yahoo! with more than 20 years of digital advertising, engineering, and marketing experience, we build tools that make enterprise-grade marketing accessible at scale.

 The Role 

 We're looking for a Backend Developer with 1–3 years of experience to join our engineering team. You'll take an active role in building, testing, and maintaining the backend services that power our platform — and you'll do it with AI as a core part of your workflow, not an afterthought. This is a role for someone who's genuinely excited about what AI-assisted development makes possible and wants to push that further every day.

 What You'll Do 

 
 Build, test, and maintain backend services across Eulerity's core platform

 Own features end-to-end — from design and implementation through deployment

 Use AI agents and LLM tooling to prototype, iterate, and ship faster

 Contribute product ideas and help shape the engineering roadmap

 Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams on features and releases

 Assist with documentation, system support, and knowledge sharing across the team

 
 About You 

 
 1–3 years of hands-on backend development experience, with at least 1 year building in Java

 You've actually used AI agents (Claude, Copilot, Cursor, or similar) to build, debug, and ship software — not just experimented with them

 Familiarity with LLMs, AI agent frameworks, or AI-assisted development workflows

 Comfortable integrating third-party APIs

 A strong drive to keep learning — especially when it comes to evolving AI tooling and how it applies to real engineering problems

 You think creatively about complex problems and enjoy finding elegant solutions

 A collaborative, communicative team player with a friendly, low-ego approach

 
 Requirements 

 
 Based in the NYC tri-state area

 Available to work full-time (40 hours/week)

 
 What We Offer 

 
 Competitive salary (commensurate with experience)

 Full GitHub Copilot access with frontier LLMs and coding agents from Anthropic, Google, and OpenAI — so you're always working with the best tooling available

 Mentorship and regular peer review sessions

 Unlimited snacks and an in-office lunch credit

 Hybrid work flexibility with at least three in-office days per week

 
 Benefits 

 
 🩺 Comprehensive benefits

 
 Medical

 Dental

 Vision

 
 🏖️ Unlimited PTO

 🚅 Commuter benefits

 📈 401(k) with company match

 😎 Summer Fridays

 
 Compensation 

 Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our company's size and industry, and are one part of the total compensation package that also includes benefits, perks, and other opportunities at Eulerity. The expected total compensation range for this role is $95,000 - $125,000, commensurate with experience.

  

 IMPORTANT 🛑

 PLEASE FILL THIS FORM . 

 If link doesn't open, please copy paste this link in your browser: 

 https://candidate-glow-garden.lovable.app/

 Only applications with a completed questionnaire will be considered.
